title: supremely lightweight, sits unevenly, Just OK.
text:
supremely lightweight, sits unevenly, Just OK.. good size for small doodads. Not all that visually appealing. Super lightweight- even more so than other seagrass baskets I have had. Kind of blah looking. I'd like it more if it had a more solid look/feel to it. It has a wonky look, uneven, somewhat wobbly..and not in a unique, charming, artistic way. Has a cheap vibe. The handles can be moves up and down, so you can angle them however you want.

All told, it really does look like how it shows in the picture.

I dont rate on price, but I will comment. I know baskets can be expensive, and I have purchased my fair share of them. So given that this is much lighter, delicate, and semi wobbly looking, I expect a lot more for the extravagant price.
